text:
On a hot summer day, the level of the water in a pond falls.
Which statement explains this?
A
The least energetic water particles escape from the surface and do not return.
B
The least energetic water particles escape from the surface and then return.
C
The most energetic water particles escape from the surface and do not return.
D
The most energetic water particles escape from the surface and then return.

options.label: A
options.text: The least energetic water particles escape from the surface and do not return.

options.label: B
options.text: The least energetic water particles escape from the surface and then return.

options.label: C
options.text: The most energetic water particles escape from the surface and do not return.

options.label: D
options.text: The most energetic water particles escape from the surface and then return.
